title: Tensor powers and duals of an invertible module after scalar extension
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, let $R\to S$ be a morphism of sheaves of commutative rings, and let $M$ be a locally free $R$-module sheaf of rank one, meaning locally isomorphic to $R$ in the category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Use tensor products and powers of [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For every integer $r\geq0$ there is a canonical natural $S$-linear isomorphism
$$ (M^{\otimes_R r})\otimes_R S\simeq(M\otimes_R S)^{\otimes_S r}, $$
where the case $r=0$ is the tensor unitor. There is also a canonical natural isomorphism
$$M^\vee\otimes_R S\simeq(M\otimes_R S)^\vee$$
with $M^\vee=\mathcal{H}om_R(M,R)$ as in [def-pur-sheaf-hom], and these comparisons commute with the tensor-power associators, the unitors, and iteration of ring maps.
